name: Combat Training raises physical damage and parry chance by 3% (#825)
contract: Combat Training 680529 (installed Spell.dbc) is a passive family-21 spell with effect 0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE (79, misc 1 = Physical) base 2 die 1 -> +3% and effect 1 SPELL_AURA_MOD_PARRY_PERCENT (47) base 2 die 1 -> +3%; the Description reads 'Increases your Physical damage dealt and parry chance by 3%.' Physical damage is read as the calculated main-hand minimum damage (UNIT_FIELD_MINDAMAGE): Player::CalculateMinMaxDamage multiplies ((weapon + attack power term) * base pct + flat) by the TOTAL_PCT unit mod that this aura feeds (StatSystem.cpp:737), so with a weapon equipped the ratio is a plain 1.03. The melee_damage_done query cannot see it: Unit::MeleeDamageBonusDone skips SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE for the physical school because 'mods for SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL are already factored in base melee damage calculation' (Unit.cpp:10782), and measured 1.000 with the talent active. Player::UpdateParryPercentage adds the aura amount to the parry field, but a class that could not parry before also gets the flat 5% base once its first parry aura flips CanParry (same reason the Nether Disciple scenario uses a band), so the parry gain is asserted as at least the aura's own 3 with a ceiling that covers that flip.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Main-hand minimum damage before the talent
Parry chance rises by at least the 3% the aura grants
